primary_rule: Current hybrid gap > 5%; signal midpoint >= $1; full spread <=10%; hybrid/market-only directional agreement; gap > signal full-spread proxy + $0.013 per share roundtrip commission
timing: signal -10, entry -9, exit -6 trading sessions before earnings; expiry after earnings
hedge: primary entry-date vendor delta; also no hedge and signal reference delta
fill: primary full bid/ask; mid and partial sensitivity
calibration: same existing reference split, Heston/mixture calibration and MarketSlice; anchor snapshots -15,-10 sessions
history: own name last 8 events, minimum6 retained for same pipeline eligibility
no_reselection: No rule modifications using these additional-name results
limitations: Historical actual calendar, quotes not guaranteed fills, European approximation
